## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Engineering
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Beams, supports, and loads
//  - Fits and machine elements
//  - Engineering materials and states of stress
//  - Cross-section profiles

//==
// # Beams, supports, and loads
//
// A straight prismatic member ready for 1D structural analysis, together with
// the restraints and loads placed along its axis. Positions are Lengths
// measured from the beam's start; load magnitudes carry the units named by
// their case.

// How a beam is restrained at a support point: translation and rotation
// (Fixed), translation only (Pinned), transverse translation only (Roller),
// or an unrestrained end (Free).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_support)
type BeamRestraint = Fixed | Pinned | Roller | Free;

// A support placed along a beam. Position is measured from the beam's start
// along its axis.
type BeamSupport
    implements IValue
{
    Restraint: BeamRestraint;
    Position: Length;
}

// A load on a beam. Positions are measured from the beam's start; each case
// carries the magnitude in its own units: newtons for PointForce, newtons
// per meter for DistributedForce (uniform over StartPosition..EndPosition),
// newton-meters for Moment. Transverse loads are positive downward by
// convention.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_load)
type BeamLoad
    implements IValue
    = PointForce(Position: Length, Magnitude: Number)
    | DistributedForce(StartPosition: Length, EndPosition: Length, Magnitude: Number)
    | Moment(Position: Length, Magnitude: Number);

// A straight prismatic beam ready for 1D structural analysis: overall length,
// section properties, material, and the supports and loads along its axis.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beam_(structure))
type Beam
{
    Length: Length;
    Section: SectionProperties;
    Material: EngineeringMaterial;
    Supports: Array<BeamSupport>;
    Loads: Array<BeamLoad>;
}

//==
// # Fits and machine elements
//
// Shaft-hole fits and the defining parameter records of standard machine
// elements: gears, bolted joints, springs, welds, pressure vessels, and
// bearings. Physical fields use quantity types (Length, Force, Pressure,
// Torque, Angle); raw Number fields are dimensionless.

//==
// # Fits and tolerances

// The engagement class of a shaft-hole pair: the shaft is always smaller
// (Clearance), may clear or interfere (Transition), or is always larger
// (Interference).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_fit)
type FitClass = Clearance | Transition | Interference;

// A cylindrical fit between a hole and a shaft at a shared nominal diameter,
// with a toleranced deviation for each member.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_tolerance)
type ShaftHoleFit
    implements IValue
{
    NominalDiameter: Length;
    HoleTolerance: Tolerance;
    ShaftTolerance: Tolerance;
    Engagement: FitClass;
}

//==
// # Machine element parameters

// Defining parameters of an involute spur gear. Module is the pitch diameter
// per tooth; ProfileShiftCoefficient is the dimensionless addendum
// modification (x-factor).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Involute_gear)
type GearParameters
    implements IValue
{
    ToothCount: Integer;
    Module: Length;
    PressureAngle: Angle;
    FaceWidth: Length;
    ProfileShiftCoefficient: Number;
}

// Defining parameters of a preloaded bolted joint: fastener geometry plus the
// installation preload and the torque that produces it.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bolted_joint)
type BoltedJointParameters
    implements IValue
{
    BoltDiameter: Length;
    ThreadPitch: Length;
    Preload: Force;
    TighteningTorque: Torque;
}

// Defining parameters of a round-wire helical compression or extension
// spring. ActiveCoils may be fractional; ShearModulus is the wire material's
// modulus of rigidity.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coil_spring)
type HelicalSpringParameters
    implements IValue
{
    WireDiameter: Length;
    MeanCoilDiameter: Length;
    ActiveCoils: Number;
    ShearModulus: Pressure;
}

// Defining parameters of a fillet weld sized for strength: leg and throat
// dimensions, the effective (load-carrying) length, and the allowable shear
// stress of the weld metal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fillet_weld)
type WeldParameters
    implements IValue
{
    LegSize: Length;
    ThroatThickness: Length;
    EffectiveLength: Length;
    AllowableStress: Pressure;
}

// Defining parameters of a thin-walled cylindrical pressure vessel under
// internal pressure.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pressure_vessel)
type PressureVesselParameters
    implements IValue
{
    InnerDiameter: Length;
    WallThickness: Length;
    InternalPressure: Pressure;
}
```
